content.short: Bait Island is a TON economy game on Telegram where players fish, farm, trade, build a village, and use BAIT.
content.description: Bait Island is positioned as an economy game on TON. Players catch fish, harvest crops, trade resources, build a village, and interact with the BAIT token economy, so its core value is the open in-game market rather than a static reward page. Fish, Farm, and Trade in the biggest open economy on Telegram. The liquidity is low because we are bootstrapping it WITH YOU. The app presents $bait token live, game features, how to earn real ton, and bait island as core parts of the workflow.
